Definition: Cham, a son of Noah; also (as a patronymic) his descendants or their country
BiblicalUsage: Ham was the second son of Noah, named with Shem and Japheth among those who went out of the ark. He saw his father's nakedness and told his two brothers outside, and his name became the name of Egypt — the tabernacles of Ham, where God smote the firstborn.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ham's story is the warning that seeing and telling are different sins: he saw, and then he told, and the telling is what the story remembers.
